dates.title: UMass Amherst - International first-year applicants (dates and deadlines)

test_policy.notes: SAT/ACT are optional for first-year applicants (international requirements page). Only about a quarter of enrolled first-years submitted SAT in the CDS.

requirements.notes: Complete Common App including the UMass questions; fee is $85 for international applicants and cannot be waived. A letter of recommendation is listed as required (number of recommenders not stated). An optional third-party unscripted interview (e.g. InitialView) may be submitted by international students. UMass does not offer early decision.

deadlines.label: Early action (non-binding)
deadlines.notes: Decisions posted by the end of January; reply date May 1.

deadlines.label: Regular decision
deadlines.notes: Decisions posted in early March per the early-action FAQ (the admission-decision page says by the end of March).

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waiver (at the Director's discretion, after document verification) for completing all four years of secondary school at a school where English is the main language of instruction with a British or American curriculum. Scores must be under two years old, sent directly from the testing agency, and no superscoring (TOEFL MyBest not accepted). Paper IELTS reports, IELTS Indicator, TOEFL ITP Plus for China, TOEFL Essentials and PTE Academic Online are not accepted.

english.notes: Exams taken before 2026-01-21. In-person or Home Edition only.
Use the same email address as on the Common App.
B2 First, C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency.
The page lists PTE Academic Online as not accepted and lists no other PTE test among the accepted options.

ielts.note: No numeric code. Ask the test center to send scores to UMass Amherst's IELTS e-download account (University of Massachusetts Amherst, 534 Goodell Building, 140 Hicks Way, Amherst, MA 01003-9333).

duolingo.note: No numeric code on the page; use the same email address as your Common App.
